response.title: Empirical Asset Pricing via Ensemble Gaussian Process Regression
response.asset_universe: large cross-section of US stocks from 1962 to 2016
response.training_protocol: partition the large training sample into subsets, apply individual GPRs on all subsets in parallel, and obtain a predictive distribution conditional on the full training data by mixing the predictive distributions over the subsets. Rolling scheme (K_t = K) and expanding scheme (K_t = t).
response.evaluation_protocol: predictive performance evaluation using out-of-sample test and validation period
response.reported_results: dominates existing machine learning models statistically and economically in terms of out-of-sample R-squared and Sharpe ratio of prediction-sorted portfolios
response.strict_requirements: gamma-exponential kernel outperformed the others in terms of R2_pool
